data.one_liner: GridView with dynamic item heights without specifying an aspect ratio.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GridView and a SliverDynamicHeightGridView that allows grid items to have dynamic heights. Removes the requirement of specifying an aspect ratio for grid elements.
use_when: You need a grid view where items have varying heights
You want to avoid calculating aspect ratios for grid cells
avoid_when: You need a staggered grid layout with complex spanning capabilities provided by specialized packages
strengths: Supports custom scroll views via SliverDynamicHeightGridView
weaknesses: Minimal feature set beyond dynamic height calculation

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you need advanced staggered grid layouts with variable spans and sizes.
